cloud_monitor.provider: Tencent Cloud TCOP basic cloud-product monitoring
proposed_rules: CPU above 90 percent for 5 minutes, if supported
Memory above 90 percent for 5 minutes, if supported and reporting
Disk above 85 percent for 5 minutes, if supported and reporting
Keep existing traffic-package alert and review warning at 20 percent
Missing data or instance events only if supported; verify semantics first

public_probe.failure_recovery_semantics: ACCOUNT_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING; do not claim old 3-failure/2-recovery contract

billing_gate: STOP if the actual account requires payment, a card, a trial, automatic paid overage or unavailable free features. No auto-upgrade.
maintenance: Manual coordination with an explicit end and recovery checks; no indefinite pause. Keep critical heartbeat/storage failure visible. No provider settings are changed by this file.
known_cost_boundary: No new service charges planned. Tiny HTTPS requests still consume existing server traffic quota; verify headroom and account billing before enablement.
